title: Declared social icons must match the profile network selected by the plan
expect: A kit-declared Twitter icon attached to a planned TikTok profile fails W03 with icon-network and return-to-planner guidance.
Matching declared Twitter icons, including the brief network alias x, remain valid.
A hidden social URL or hidden block produces no icon-network failure.
An undeclared TikTok class still fails icon-field; the checker never assumes that a font includes an unsupported glyph.
fence: The kept plan link selects the social fact, the fact names its network, and the same explicit kit row names its icon backing field and declared network.

tests: a declared social glyph cannot pass for a different planned profile network
social network checking preserves matching declared icons and hidden or omitted links
an unavailable matching social class still cannot bypass kit icon constraints
